citation: Source-linked fluid and continuum mechanics additions.

records.output: Mass flow rate
records.source_locator: Equation 10
records.notes: A is cross-sectional area, p_t and T_t are stagnation pressure and temperature, R is the specific gas constant, gamma is the heat-capacity ratio, and M is Mach number. Isentropic calorically perfect gas.
records.name: Mass flow rate

records.output: Local-to-sonic cross-sectional area ratio
records.source_locator: Equation 9
records.notes: M is local Mach number and gamma is the heat-capacity ratio. Isentropic calorically perfect gas with M > 0.
records.name: Local-to-sonic cross-sectional area ratio

records.output: Squared downstream Mach number across a normal shock
records.source_locator: Equation for downstream Mach number, printed as M1^2
records.notes: M_up is upstream Mach number greater than one, and gamma is the heat-capacity ratio. Steady, one-dimensional adiabatic normal shock in a calorically perfect gas.
records.name: Squared downstream Mach number across a normal shock

records.output: Downstream-to-upstream static pressure ratio across a normal shock
records.source_locator: Equation for static pressure ratio, printed as p1/p0
records.notes: M_up is upstream Mach number greater than one, and gamma is the heat-capacity ratio. Steady, one-dimensional adiabatic normal shock in a calorically perfect gas.
records.name: Downstream-to-upstream static pressure ratio across a normal shock

records.output: Flat-plate 99% boundary-layer thickness
records.source_locator: Lecture 16, Blasius layer thickness at 99% of free-stream speed
records.notes: nu is kinematic viscosity, x is downstream distance, and U_inf is free-stream speed. Laminar incompressible flow over a flat plate at zero pressure gradient.
records.name: Flat-plate 99% boundary-layer thickness

records.output: Local flat-plate wall shear stress magnitude
records.source_locator: Lecture 16, Wall shear stress; Reynolds number expanded
records.notes: rho is fluid density, nu is kinematic viscosity, x is downstream distance, and U_inf is free-stream speed. Laminar incompressible flow over a flat plate at zero pressure gradient.
records.name: Local flat-plate wall shear stress magnitude

records.output: Downstream-to-upstream water depth ratio across a hydraulic jump
records.source_locator: Equation 3
records.notes: Fr_up is the upstream Froude number greater than one. Horizontal rectangular open channel under the classical momentum-balance assumptions.
records.name: Downstream-to-upstream water depth ratio across a hydraulic jump

records.output: Critical water depth in a rectangular open channel
records.source_locator: Critical-flow relation; solves V_c^2 = g D_c using q = V_c D_c
records.notes: q is volumetric discharge per unit width and g is gravitational acceleration.
records.name: Critical water depth in a rectangular open channel

records.output: Penetration distance in a horizontal cylindrical capillary
records.source_locator: Washburn (1921), abstract on liquid penetration
records.notes: gamma is surface tension, r is tube radius, t is elapsed time, theta is contact angle, and eta is dynamic viscosity. Capillary driving with negligible slip and inertia.
records.name: Penetration distance in a horizontal cylindrical capillary

records.output: Squared angular frequency of a free liquid drop's shape oscillation
records.source_locator: Wang, Anilkumar and Lee, Equation 1.2
records.notes: sigma is surface tension, rho is liquid density, R is the equilibrium radius, and n is integer mode number at least two. Linear perturbation of an inviscid drop with negligible ambient-fluid inertia.
records.name: Squared angular frequency of a free liquid drop's shape oscillation

records.output: Still-water settling speed of a sediment grain
records.source_locator: Ferguson and Church (2004), Equation 4
records.notes: Delta is submerged relative grain density, g is gravitational acceleration, d is grain diameter, nu is fluid kinematic viscosity, and C_1 and C_2 are drag parameters.
records.name: Still-water settling speed of a sediment grain

records.output: Steady radial discharge to a well
records.source_locator: Thiem relation, Equation 14, converted from quarter discharge
records.notes: T is transmissivity and h_outer and h_inner are hydraulic heads at the corresponding radii r_outer > r_inner. Steady horizontal radial flow in a homogeneous isotropic confined aquifer. Positive discharge is toward the well.
records.name: Steady radial discharge to a well

records.output: Shear stress magnitude in yielded viscoplastic fluid
records.source_locator: Equations 3–4, restricted to the magnitude for simple shear
records.notes: tau_y is yield stress, K is consistency, n is the flow index, and shear_rate is the positive magnitude of the shear rate. Yielded, steady simple shear.
records.name: Shear stress magnitude in yielded viscoplastic fluid

records.output: Effective axial solute diffusivity in a straight circular tube
records.source_locator: Equation 17
records.notes: Laminar Poiseuille flow at times long relative to transverse molecular diffusion time. U_mean is the mean flow speed, R the tube radius, and D_m the molecular diffusivity.
records.name: Effective axial solute diffusivity in a straight circular tube

records.output: Film thickness deposited on a withdrawn plate
records.source_locator: Equation 1.1 with capillary length and capillary number substituted
records.notes: Fully wetting vertical plate withdrawn steadily at speed U from a Newtonian bath at small capillary number. gamma is surface tension, mu dynamic viscosity, rho density, and g gravitational acceleration.
records.name: Film thickness deposited on a withdrawn plate

records.output: Axial vorticity in an axisymmetric Burgers vortex
records.source_locator: Equation 5, multiplied by circulation
records.notes: Steady incompressible axisymmetric vortex with circulation Gamma in a uniform axial strain field at rate strain > 0. nu is kinematic viscosity, r radial distance.
records.name: Axial vorticity in an axisymmetric Burgers vortex

records.output: Subsurface vertical stress increment from a point load
records.source_locator: Theory, Equation 1
records.notes: Homogeneous isotropic linearly elastic half-space under a vertical surface point load Q. z is depth greater than zero, r is horizontal offset. Positive compressive stress.
records.name: Subsurface vertical stress increment from a point load

records.output: Radius of a circular Hertzian contact
records.source_locator: Equations 2 and 3, source modulus convention retained
records.notes: F is compressive normal force, R spherical radius, and E_prime is twice the reduced modulus under the source's convention. Small nonadhesive elastic contact between a sphere and a plane.
records.name: Radius of a circular Hertzian contact

records.output: Magnitude of shear-induced lift on a rigid sphere with slip
records.source_locator: Section 3.7 (printed p. 44) and definition Re_k = a^2 G / nu, corrected Saffman coefficient
records.notes: Unbounded Newtonian simple shear with positive shear rate magnitude G, sphere radius a, dynamic viscosity mu, kinematic viscosity nu and slip speed U_slip. Asymptotic small shear Reynolds number, with slip Reynolds number much smaller than its square root.
records.name: Magnitude of shear-induced lift on a rigid sphere with slip

records.output: Retraction speed of an initially stationary liquid sheet
records.source_locator: Section 1, corrected Taylor–Culick speed relative to Equation 1.1
records.notes: Uniform sheet of thickness H with two interfaces, liquid density rho and surface tension gamma. Negligible ambient phase inertia and gas drag.
records.name: Retraction speed of an initially stationary liquid sheet

records.output: Upward volume flux of a turbulent buoyant plume
records.source_locator: Equation 3.2
records.notes: Classical pure plume in an unstratified quiescent ambient, with constant buoyancy flux B and entrainment-dependent coefficient C_e. Height z measured from the actual source and virtual origin at -z0.
records.name: Upward volume flux of a turbulent buoyant plume

records.output: Critical Shields parameter for sediment motion
records.source_locator: Equation 2-132
records.notes: d_star is dimensionless grain diameter as defined in the technical reference. Empirical threshold for incipient grain motion on a noncohesive sediment bed.
records.name: Critical Shields parameter for sediment motion

records.output: Volume flow rate per unit width in a gravity-driven falling film
records.source_locator: Equation 2.1 solved for flow rate per width using nu = mu/rho
records.notes: Steady smooth laminar Newtonian film of thickness h on a plane inclined by theta from the horizontal, no slip at the wall and a shear-free interface. nu is kinematic viscosity.
records.name: Volume flow rate per unit width in a gravity-driven falling film

records.output: Steady small deformation of a drop in simple shear
records.source_locator: Small-deformation Taylor theory in the section on steady-state droplet shape
records.notes: Clean isolated Newtonian drop in Newtonian ambient, in creeping flow at small capillary number Ca. visc_ratio is drop divided by ambient viscosity. Deformation is the difference of major and minor axes divided by their sum.
records.name: Steady small deformation of a drop in simple shear

records.output: Fluid velocity parallel to an oscillating flat wall
records.source_locator: Lecture 16, Stokes' second problem, page 13
records.notes: Newtonian incompressible half-space in periodic steady state above a plane oscillating at frequency omega with wall velocity amplitude U_0. y is wall-normal distance and nu kinematic viscosity.
records.name: Fluid velocity parallel to an oscillating flat wall
